# `aitbc exchange prepay deposit`

Deposit Sepolia ETH into this node's prepaid exchange balance. Sends to the hub's bridge deposit address with the ``EXCHANGE_DEPOSIT:<node address>`` input-data tag; the deposit monitor records it 'exchange_prepay' and the settlement monitor credits the prepaid balance (and auto-funds any open unfunded BUYs, in id order).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange prepay deposit [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--amount-eth` | decimal | — | yes | Sepolia ETH to deposit |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name or file path — the node's own registered wallet |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--send` | flag | `false` | no | Sign and broadcast once (default: print the unsigned tx) |
| `--max-eth` | decimal | `0.01` | no | Per-call deposit cap — raise explicitly for larger deposits |
| `--exchange-url` | text | — | no | Override exchange service base URL |
| `--eth-rpc-url` | text | — | no | Sepolia JSON-RPC endpoint (default: ETH_RPC_URL env/config) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange prepay deposit --amount-eth <amount_eth>
```
